title: Single Store Dispatch Gate for All UI Interactions
description: All UI interactions (hover, click, unfold, etc.) MUST be dispatched through a single store.dispatch() method on SketchpadStore. This is the single gate. No hook should call actor.send() directly. Instead: store.dispatch(event) → logs → actor.send(). Remove actor proxy, add dispatch(), update all hooks.
summary:
Routed ALL production actor.send() calls through store.dispatch() as the single dispatch gate.

Architecture:
- SketchpadStore.dispatch(event) → logInteraction() → actor.send(event) — single gate for ALL XState events
- Hooks call store.dispatch() instead of actor.send() directly
- Sub-stores (KitAppStoreImpl, DesignStore) call this.parent.dispatch() / this.parentStore.dispatch() for XState sync
- Test code (page.evaluate) retains direct actor.send since it tests the XState machine directly from browser context

Updated locations:
- 6 settings hooks (useTheme, useLanguage, useDevice, useMode, useExpertise, useFullscreen)
- useSketchpadActions (11 methods)
- useXStateField, useXStateFieldWithScope, useXStateAction
- useHomeCommands (16 methods)
- useAppCommands HOME case
- 8 TYPE viewport hooks (useTypeAppCamera, useTypeAppFocusedConnectorGuid, useTypeAppHover, useTypeAppActiveTool, useTypeAppIsPortSelected, useTypeAppIsPortHovered, useTypeAppSelectedModelGuid, useTypeAppSelectedModelTags)
- 5 FEEDBACK hooks
- 3 BACKGROUND hooks (HomeDropZone)
- KitAppStoreImpl.executeCommand (10 actor sync calls → this.parent.dispatch)
- DesignStore.executeCommand (12 actor sync calls → this.parentStore.dispatch)
- setKitTableSelection, KitToolbarSelection
- useKitAppYjsToXStateSync (KIT.INIT, KIT.SYNC)
- useDesignAppInitialize (DESIGN.INIT)
- useDesignAppField
- useDesignAppYjsToXStateSync (DESIGN.SYNC)
- useTypeAppInitialize (TYPE.INIT)

Remaining actor.send calls: 1 inside SketchpadStore.dispatch() (the forwarding destination) + 33 in Playwright test code (page.evaluate).
